builtins.len: len(value): string/list/object → number; strings count Unicode scalar values.
builtins.str: str(value): Data → string; other Data uses canonical JSON.
builtins.range: range(end), range(start, end), range(start, end, step): half-open list of safe integers.
builtins.map: map(xs, f): list and pure unary function → list, in input order.
builtins.fold: fold(xs, seed, f): strict left fold; f(accumulator, element).
builtins.fail: fail(message): stop with E-FAIL; no successful value.
builtins.concat: concat(a, b): concatenate two lists into a new list.
builtins.slice: slice(value, start, end): half-open list/string slice; safe nonnegative indices.
builtins.keys: keys(object): string keys sorted by UTF-8 bytes.
builtins.has: has(object, key): check whether a string key exists.
builtins.put: put(object, key, value): return a new object with that field added or replaced.
builtins.split: split(text, separator): nonempty separator; preserves empty parts.
builtins.parse_number: parse_number(text): complete ASCII numeric text → finite number.

Pure function.description: Pure function; final expression is its result

Parallel Claim.description: Append facts in a parallel loop

Proposal.description: Construct a proposal without executing it

Pipeline.description: Static pipeline stage; input is its first argument

Multiline string.description: Multiline string; indentation is part of its value
